name: dextra-operations-team
description: Governed cross-domain operations team: splits a request into finance, HR, and inventory parts, has each specialist produce its own output with sources, and consolidates one report. No member approves, issues a mandate, or executes anything.

displayDescription.en: Splits a cross-domain operations request into finance, HR, and inventory work, has each specialist deliver its own sourced output, then consolidates one report with every figure traced to a source. No member approves or executes.
displayDescription.zh: 把跨域运营需求拆给财务、人力、库存三名成员，收回带来源的产出后汇总成一份运营报告，不做决策与审批。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Put together this month's operations review — pull what you need from finance, HR, and inventory, and cite each source.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 汇总本月运营复盘，从财务、人力、库存取数，并标注各自来源。

quickPrompts.en: Put together this month's operations review — pull what you need from finance, HR, and inventory, and cite each source.
quickPrompts.zh: 汇总本月运营复盘，从财务、人力、库存取数，并标注各自来源。

quickPrompts.en: Two departments report different headcount numbers — show both with their sources instead of picking one.
quickPrompts.zh: 两个部门报的人数不一致，把两个数字和来源都列出来，不要替我选。

quickPrompts.en: Which items are below reorder point, and what does that do to this month's cost?
quickPrompts.zh: 哪些物料低于补货点？这对本月成本有什么影响？

profession.zh: 薪酬与财务报告分析师
人力资源数据与人事运营
